notes.title: Apology for delaying our final release
notes.notes:
Hey Guys!

First of all we want to apologise for delaying our final release!

The reason being for that is our dissatisfaction about the current stage of the game. We want you to have the best possible experience with the fully developed game.
However in our lights that would not be the case now.
Accordingly we are still working on improving the user's experience and developing further features!
Thus, we are delaying the release date until the second quarter of 2023.

Until then, we sincerely invite you to join our community on our social media channels to take part in this developing journey, as we are planning to work closely with you guys. 
Resulting in a game which we developed together! 

We apologise again for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Update 0.7.0.0 - 02/04/2022 - Dangers
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

First of all, we would like to apologize for the delay, since we wanted to release this update on 31/03/2022. However, we hope that you will like the new features.

There lies danger in the dark. Evil robots from the unknown attack your village at night and try to hinder your villages growth!

Luckily, you can fight them off by building Barracks which allow you to train Soldiers and lead them into the fight!

Other Changes:
- Fixed the screen looking washed out after the last update
- Added torch fire to the beach torches

Thank you for your support and good luck on the battlefield!

notes.title: Update 0.6.1.0 - 09/02/2022
notes.notes:
Adds new, progressively unlocked tutorials explaining the game in more detail.

Other changes:
- Fixed an error when loading  the game
- Fixed Continue button being available even if no savegame exists
- Fixed Villager Menu not showing after clicking on villager
- Forester Villagers now only chop selected trees

notes.title: Important Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

As you may have already seen, we are planning to release Operation: VICUS on January 17th 2022 in an Early Access State. This way, we can show players, what to expect from the final product and receive feedback about bugs and features. After the Early Access release, we will be releasing regular free updates for the next 6 months that will expand the game with content, a storyline, bug fixes and Quality of Life improvements until it is complete. More details and a roadmap will be provided on January 17th.

Thank you for reading and see you on the island in January,
Intensity Games.
